cohort: Participants were 71,799 Japanese women from the Japan Environment and Children's Study with singleton pregnancies after 22 weeks of gestation who gave birth during 2011-2014.
finding: A pre-pregnancy BMI ≥ 25.0 kg/m2 significantly increased the likelihood of foetal acidosis in newborns delivered vaginally.
mod_finding: A pre-pregnancy BMI ≥ 25.0 kg/m2 increased the likelihood of foetal acidosis in vaginally delivered newborns, but no association was found between pre-pregnancy BMI and foetal acidosis in newborns delivered via caesarean section.
